{{Quote|Haari Ikreme Beeerd, at your service. Any enemy of Grunta is a friend to us all.|Haari Ikreme Beeerd to Han Solo|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Haari Ikreme Beeerd''' was a [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]] crewman who served on [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Gilag Pitaaani]]'s [[Podracing/Legends|racing]] team, which was sponsored by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Chenik Kruun]]. Beeerd was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and initially befriended the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] upon learning that Solo had [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Grunta]], a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] podracer whom Beeerd disliked. However, when Beeered revealed that he placed a bet that Han's friend, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], would not survive the first ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of the [[Muunilinst Podrace|podrace]], Solo punched him in the face, sparking a brawkl with the other podracing crew<ref name="Target" />
